issues.issue: Whether the court should hear the application although it is moot
issues.applicant_position: Court should decide it: the issue will recur in later detention reviews and the parties asked for a decision before April 29.
issues.respondent_position: Also asked the Court to exercise discretion and decide the matter before the April 29 detention review.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that this is an appropriate case in which to exercise my discretion to hear what would otherwise be a moot application.

issues.issue: Whether s. 58(1)(c) permits continued detention where the original detention was under s. 55(2)(a), not s. 55(3)
issues.applicant_position: Section 58(1)(c) is available for continued detention whatever the original ground; the Immigration Division's contrary reading is unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Continued detention under s. 58(1)(c) is only available where the original detention was under s. 55(3) at a port of entry.

issues.issue: Whether Charter values or liberty interests require a narrower reading of s. 58(1)(c)
issues.respondent_position: Section 58(1)(c) should be read consistently with Charter liberty values to protect the detainee.
issues.result_quote: I have found no such ambiguity here.
